decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed mansard roof extension, due to its design, bulk and top-heavy appearance, and the position of the building on a highly visible junction, would result in an overbearing and incongruous development, out of scale and character with the original building, and detrimental to the visual and residential amenities of the area, contrary to adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1 and H.1.2 and Revised Deposit Version (January 2001) UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 and H 4.1.

Condition : 2 - 2/ The proposed development for two additional self contained residential flats would fail to meet the Council's parking standards and would result in increased pressure on the existing CPZ resulting in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to Adopted UDP policy T.2.5, and Revised Deposit Version (January 2001) UDP policy T.1.4
description: Erection of a mansard roof extension comprising of 2 self contained flats.
